source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. Each run directory's manifest (tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py) lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes. The run directories were created under the working root's runtime-evidence folder and moved unchanged to review-artifacts, so the work_dir and output paths recorded inside each run.json name the original location.
